name: Apply Wall Primer (Spray + Backroll, Combined Wall+Ceiling Pass)
intent: Wall prime variant for the pre-trim NC workflow where walls and ceiling are primed in one continuous spray pass. Identical task list to MOD_APPLY_WALL_PRIME_SPRAY_BACKROLL. Rates are expected to be tuned up slightly once painter data confirms the combined-pace speedup (continuous flow, less pausing between substrates). For Phase 1A the baseline rates match non-combined; tune via the Modifier UI.
doctrine: Combined-pass variant of MOD_APPLY_WALL_PRIME_SPRAY_BACKROLL. Scenarios that match ctx.prime_mode === 'combined' use this module instead of the standard version. Task list is identical — the savings in combined mode come from (a) shared scenario-level setup/teardown dedup, (b) per-task cleanup gating (floor teardown tasks fire only in separate mode), and (c) optional rate overrides on these task_refs once painter data justifies them. For Phase 1A, rates are unchanged from non-combined. Next step: author rate_per_hour overrides here after verifying combined-pace speedup on a job.
